    Restriction and extension of interval families #

    Section 8 of the manuscript. An intersection-closed family on n + 1 vertices restricts to one on the first n vertices (ClosedFamily.restrict); the families restricting to a given D are the extensions D_J by intervals [a, n] with a in a subset J of the admissible starts adm D (Construction 8.3, Lemma 8.4(1): glue, glue_JOf, JOf_subset_adm), and the admissible starts of D_J are counted by admCount (Lemma 8.4(2): card_adm_glue).

    Summing over the fibres gives the recurrence (8.7) for the generating polynomial fSum n = Σ_D q^{|D|} z^{|adm D|} (fSum_succ) and the formula (8.8) Σ_{C ∈ L_im(Λ_{n+1})} x^{ρ} q^{|ind C|} = fSum n (1 + qx) (xSum_succ). Substituting z = 1 + qx turns (8.7) into the recurrence of the q-Gandhi polynomials of the second kind (isGandhiSecond_gandhiSecondOf), which proves Theorem 8.5 (xSum_eq).
